capture_kind: application debug logs, not raw Bluetooth HCI/btsnoop

erg_machine_type.field: individual 0x0032 octet 16, and multiplexed 0x32 payload octet 18 (both uint8)
erg_machine_type.interpretation: 0x00 = static Model D RowErg; 0xC0 = BikeErg. The individual 0x0032 places erg machine type at octet 16, its last octet. The multiplexed 0x32 payload is 19 octets and appends average power at 16..17, pushing erg machine type to octet 18.
erg_machine_type.conclusion: Two RowErgs (PM5 530382227 Row, PM5 430392046) and one BikeErg (PM5 530268844). No SkiErg appears in this set.
erg_machine_type.additional: The CE060016 Erg Machine Type characteristic does not exist at all on the 430392046 unit, which independently supports the ErgData finding that a client cannot rely on 0x0016 for persona classification.

values_observed.0x00 RowErg: 4487 individual frames across the five Android sessions
values_observed.0xC0 BikeErg: 2988 multiplexed frames in the macOS session

erg_machine_type.multiplexed_layout_evidence: Reading payload 16..17 as uint16 LE yields 0-110 with octet 17 always zero, consistent with average power in watts; octet 18 is constant 0xC0 across all 2,988 frames, consistent with a type field and not with a metric. Both readings agree only under this layout.
erg_machine_type.correction_note: An earlier revision of this fixture stated that no BikeErg appeared in these logs and that the macOS unit's erg type was not established. Both were wrong: the type is carried at a shifted offset on the multiplexed path, not absent from it. The source file name 'bikedebug...' was correct all along.

observations.delivery_path_note: Five sessions used the individual CE0600xx characteristics; one (macOS, QZ build 886) used only the multiplexed 0x0080 characteristic. Both paths are represented in the vectors, which is what makes this corpus useful against Concept2Measurement's individual-vs-multiplexed divergence.

multiplexed_payload_lengths_confirmed.note: Measured over 15,315 multiplexed frames. These match Concept2Measurement.kt's documented multiplexed table exactly, including the 0x33 = 18-octet form that diverges mid-frame from the 20-octet individual layout. This is physical-hardware corroboration of that table.

ftms_rower_data_2ad1.advertised_by: PM5 530382227 Row only (0x1826 present in its advertisement; absent from PM5 430392046)
ftms_rower_data_2ad1.behaviour: The PM splits FTMS Rower Data across two strictly alternating frames. 0x0AFF (19 octets) sets More Data, so stroke rate/count are omitted, and carries average stroke rate, distance, instantaneous and average pace, instantaneous and average power, resistance, heart rate and elapsed time. 0x0100 (10 octets) clears More Data and carries stroke rate, stroke count and the expended-energy triple. Neither frame alone is a complete sample.
ftms_rower_data_2ad1.field_walk_check: Both shapes consume exactly their full length under a standard FTMS Rower Data walk (19/19 and 10/10), so the flag interpretation is field-exact rather than approximate.

qz_decoder_defect_observed.where: QZ's own 'PM5 CE060035 RAW: ... Stroke Length: Xm' line
qz_decoder_defect_observed.detail: On 5 of 2,793 all-zero 0x0035 frames QZ printed a non-zero stroke length carried over from the previous frame. FitBridge's decode of the same bytes yields 0. Recorded so the qz_reported fields in this fixture are not mistaken for ground truth on zero frames.
qz_decoder_defect_observed.cross_check_result: 0x0036 stroke power matched QZ on 1408/1408 frames; 0x0035 drive length matched on 2788/2793.

unresolved: Multiplexed identifiers 0x3C, 0x3E and 0x3F, and individual 0x003D, appear in the logs but are not decoded by this extractor. 0x3E arrives at the same 1 Hz cadence as 0x31/0x32/0x33 and is likely a further status frame.

QZ never performs a GATT read, so the CE060010 Device Information characteristics (module number, serial, hardware/firmware revision, manufacturer, erg machine type) are discovered but never read. No firmware revision is recoverable from these logs.
observations.privacy: Bluetooth addresses and platform device identifiers are excluded from this fixture. Advertised names are retained because the ' Row' suffix is protocol-relevant.

gap_and_gatt_service.detail: QZ discovers 0x1800 (GAP) and 0x1801 (GATT) and enumerates their characteristic handles, then performs no GATT read anywhere in any of the six logs. Device Name 0x2A00, Appearance 0x2A01, Peripheral Preferred Connection Parameters 0x2A04 and Central Address Resolution 0x2AA6 are located but never fetched, so no value for any of them is recoverable here.

only_gap_write.note: Indication subscribed in all five Android sessions; 0x2A05 never fired afterwards.

gap_and_gatt_service.characteristic_properties: Not recoverable. QZ logs only characteristic UUID and handle, never the property bitmask, so read/write/notify/indicate flags are unknown for every characteristic in this corpus, GAP included.
gap_and_gatt_service.structural_difference: PM5 430392046 exposes no Central Address Resolution characteristic (0x2AA6) and its GAP service is two handles shorter. A central that assumes 0x2AA6 is present on a PM5, or that hard-codes GAP handle offsets, will not work across both units.
gap_and_gatt_service.macos_session: PM5 530268844 shows no GAP or GATT service at all, because CoreBluetooth does not expose 0x1800/0x1801 to applications. Absence there is a platform artefact, not device behaviour.

observations.advertising_correction_note: An earlier revision of this fixture recorded a field named advertising_payload_len = 31. That was wrong. The numeric pair QZ prints after the address is QBluetoothDeviceInfo majorDeviceClass:minorDeviceClass, not a length: a Scosche Rhythm 24 in the same logs prints 9:8 (HealthDevice:HeartRateMonitor). No advertising payload length is recoverable from these logs, and no raw AD structures are present.

gatt_inventory_by_unit.significance: Two physically distinct PM5 generations, plus a BikeErg on the macOS session. The 430392046 unit is a pre-FTMS PM5: it advertises only the C2 discovery UUID, exposes no FTMS/HRS/battery service, no CE060040, no 0x003C-0x003F, and a Device Information service limited to 0x0012-0x0015. It is a directly attested template for an 'old-style PM5' simulator persona. The 530382227 unit is the later generation and adds all of the above plus GAP 0x2AA6. Neither unit exposes CE060043, the force-curve-by-distance characteristic ErgData optionally looks for.
gatt_inventory_by_unit.note_on_003c: 0x003C is absent from both units' individual-characteristic enumeration, yet a 0x3C frame appears once on the multiplexed 0x0080 stream of the macOS session. Multiplexing an identifier does not require the individual characteristic to exist.

evidence_limit: These logs establish PM5 advertising, discovered GATT and both notification delivery paths for two RowErgs, plus a full multiplexed telemetry stream from a BikeErg. They contain no SkiErg, no CE060020 CSAFE control-point write or response, and no GATT reads, so they validate neither the CSAFE codec nor any device-information decoding. The BikeErg session is macOS/CoreBluetooth, so it carries no advertising or GAP/GATT evidence.
